description.value: Brentwood Cycle is a locally owned and operated bike shop that has served the Greater Victoria area for over 40 years, situated in Brentwood Bay just minutes from the Lochside Trail to Swartz Bay and the Mount Work trail network. The shop carries a broad range of bikes (mountain, gravel, urban, electric, dirt jump, kids) alongside a full accessories and apparel selection, with an in-house service department staffed by experienced technicians. Its location near a major multi-use trail corridor and ferry terminus makes it a natural stop for touring cyclists passing through the Saanich Peninsula.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is active (Shopify, © 2026) and richly detailed. Services page explicitly states experienced technicians handle repairs on all bike types including e-bikes, and the front page prominently advertises 'Same Day Service Turn-Around' confirming same-day capability. Phone 250-652-4649 on the website matches OSM tag +1-250-652-4649; no street address appears in the fetched website text, so address confirmation is null. OSM community is listed as 'Sidney' but the website clearly places the shop in Brentwood Bay / Central Saanich.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the business is located in Brentwood Bay / Central Saanich, not Sidney proper — minor geographic mislabeling in OSM.
Street address (2136 Keating Cross Road) could not be verified from website content as no address text appeared in the fetched pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, long-established bike shop with a functioning website, confirmed phone number, full service department, and a location directly adjacent to the Lochside Trail — highly relevant to touring cyclists.

Staff help with urgent mechanical issues.detail: At Brentwood Cycle, we offer both walk-in and online booking. We offer same day repair for scheduled appointments.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: 'Same Day Service Turn-around' and 'Book a Service Appointment Same Day Turn-Around!' prominently featured on the front page

E-bike service.detail: Services page explicitly states: 'From high-end road bikes and full-suspension mountain bikes to e-bikes, our team has the expertise to keep your bike in top condition.'
